Gloria’s Latin Cuisine Menu

Appetizer Selection: Kickstart Your Experience

Latin cuisine is rich in vibrant flavors and textures, and the appetizer selection at Gloria’s® Latin Cuisine sets the tone for an unforgettable meal. Whether you’re browsing the latin cuisine menu or looking to order online, these starters bring together traditional ingredients and modern flair.

Appetizer Ingredients Price (USD)
Guacamole & Chips Fresh avocado, cilantro, lime, tortilla chips $7.99
Queso Blanco Melted queso fresco, green chilies, tortilla strips $6.99
Shrimp Ceviche Citrus marinate, red onion, tomato, cilantro $9.99
Chicken Flautas Rolled tortilla with shredded chicken, sour cream sauce $8.49
Stuffed Poblano Pepper Baked pepper stuffed with chicken, topped with jack cheese $9.49

 

Appetizers like the shrimp ceviche are crafted to reflect coastal Latin culinary traditions. Explore the history and preparation of ceviche to understand its global cultural significance.

Tortilla Varieties and Accompaniments

Whether it’s flour or corn tortillas, Gloria’s offers a flexible range of choices that cater to diverse taste preferences. Each entree allows for your choice of flour or corn.

Tortilla Option Description
Corn Tortilla Traditional Mesoamerican staple, made with masa harina
Flour Tortilla Soft, pliable, and perfect for wrapping grilled chicken or ground beef

Salsa & Sauce Toppings

Many dishes are sauce topped to elevate flavor:

  • Ranchero Sauce: Tomato-based, mildly spicy
  • Adobada Sauce: Rich, smoky, perfect on enchiladas
  • Sour Cream Sauce: Creamy and cooling
  • Chipotle Ranch: Served with pickled slaw on tacos

Learn more about the differences in Latin sauces to enhance your culinary knowledge.

Guacamole, Queso, and Dips

Creamy guacamole and warm queso dips are the heart of any Latin appetizer spread. Served with crispy tortilla chips, these dips are best enjoyed fresh. The queso fresco and monterey jack cheese offer different flavor profiles that complement meats and veggies alike.

Guacamole Ingredients:

  • Ripe avocado
  • Lime juice
  • Cilantro
  • Tomato
  • Salt

See how guacamole has been a culinary staple for centuries on Smithsonian’s food history site.

Main Courses: Enchiladas, Tacos, and More

Enchiladas

A staple in any latin cuisine menu, enchiladas at Gloria’s come with a variety of fillings and sauces.

Enchilada Type Filling Sauce Price (USD)
Chicken Enchiladas Shredded chicken, monterey jack cheese Cream sauce or ranchero sauce $11.99
Ground Beef Enchiladas Seasoned ground beef, jack cheese Chili con carne $11.49
Vegetarian Enchiladas Bell peppers, red onion, feta cheese Sour cream and green tomatillo $10.99

Each dish is served with Spanish rice and black beans, a traditional combination across Latin America. Learn more about Latin rice and bean pairings.

Tacos

Tacos are served on corn tortilla or flour tortilla, topped with lettuce, pico de gallo, jack cheese, and your choice of grilled chicken breast, ground beef, or grilled shrimp.

Taco Type Protein Add-ons Price (USD)
Chicken Taco Grilled chicken breast Sour cream, lettuce, pico de gallo $3.99
Shrimp Taco Grilled shrimp Pickled slaw and chipotle ranch $4.49
Beef Taco Ground beef Queso, avocado, jalapeno $3.99

See how the taco evolved in North America from its traditional roots at National Geographic.

Specialty Meats: From Chicken to Lobster Tail

Chicken Breast with Garlic Sauce

This dish features grilled chicken breast with a house-made garlic sauce, served with Spanish rice and pinto beans.

  • Garnished with monterey jack cheese
  • Side of tortilla chips
  • Order online availability: Yes

Lobster Tail with Ranchero Sauce

Succulent lobster tail prepared in a ranchero sauce, garnished with queso fresco.

  • Served with two jumbo shrimp
  • Side of black bean soup
  • Suggested drink: Award-winning house margarita swirled with sangria

Explore seafood in Latin cuisine to understand why dishes like this are prized.

Burritos, Flautas, and More

Burritos

Our burritos are large, hearty, and filled with shredded cheese, your choice of grilled chicken breast or ground beef, then sauce topped.

  • Side of french fries or black beans
  • Add chile con queso on top for extra flavor
  • Con queso and your choice of meat available

Chicken Flautas

Deep-fried tortilla rolls filled with choice of shredded chicken, topped with sour cream sauce on top and sautéed poblano peppers.

  • Side of Spanish rice and pinto beans
  • Garnished with sour cream and avocado

Read about the difference between taquitos and flautas on Bon Appétit.

Sides & Salads

Sides:

  • Black beans
  • Spanish rice
  • Tortilla chips
  • French fries
  • Beans and guacamole

Salads:

  • Spring Mix with honey balsamic vinaigrette dressing
  • Grilled Chicken Salad with queso fresco, pico de gallo

Explore the role of beans in Latin American diets on Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health.

Desserts: Sweet Endings

Dessert Description Price (USD)
Flan Creamy custard topped with caramel drizzled on top $5.99
Fried Ice Cream Crunchy coating, topped with vanilla ice cream and cinnamon $6.49
Churros Fried dough, filled with chocolate, served with vanilla ice cream $6.99

See how desserts like churros connect cultures by visiting The Cultural History of Churros.

Drinks & Margaritas

The house favorite is the award-winning house margarita swirled with sangria, topped with grand marnier.

Other drink options:

  • Sangria
  • Jarritos
  • Horchata

Understand the origins of Latin drinks at Epicurious.

If you’re craving Southern comfort food with convenient delivery, explore the full O’Charley’s menu and order your favorites online.

Menu for Gloria’s: Ordering and Availability

You can view the full menu for Gloria’s and order online via the official website. Gloria’s operates several locations including a delivery radius near NY 11225.

For the most current hours, availability, and seasonal menu updates, check their official portal.

Food Safety and Dietary Notes

Please note: Eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness if undercooked. All dishes are made fresh, and customization is available for dietary needs.

For food safety tips and allergy guides, visit the FDA’s Food Safety page.

Conclusion: Gloria’s® Latin Cuisine Experience

Whether you’re exploring authentic latin cuisine for the first time or a loyal fan of Gloria’s restaurant, the menu offers something for everyone—from creamy queso, crispy tortilla appetizers, and sizzling enchiladas, to seafood favorites like lobster tail. With a robust selection of traditional and contemporary flavors, and the ability to order online, Gloria’s redefines the Latin dining experience for guests everywhere.

Take a deeper dive into Latin cuisine origins and cooking traditions with the Oxford Research Encyclopedia on Latin American food.
